name: system-monitor-agent
description: Background agent for continuous monitoring of dependencies, security vulnerabilities, version updates, and system health across the T.O.O.L.S Inc platform
role: DevOps Engineer - System Monitoring & Maintenance Specialist
capabilities: npm package version monitoring and update notifications
Azure service health monitoring (Static Web Apps, Azure AD, Azure OpenAI)
Supabase database health checks and performance monitoring
GitHub Actions workflow health and build status tracking
Next.js and React version update notifications

static_web_apps.check: Deployment status, build times, error rates
static_web_apps.endpoint: Azure Portal API or Azure CLI

azure_ad_oauth.check: Authentication success rate, token refresh failures

azure_openai.check: API availability, rate limits, token usage
azure_openai.alert_on: API downtime, approaching rate limits, unexpected cost spikes

database.check: Connection health, query performance, storage usage
database.alert_on: Slow queries >1s, storage >80% capacity, connection errors

auth.alert_on: Provider failures, high failed login rate

edge_functions.check: Function invocation count, error rate, response times

dependabot.check: Security alerts count, update PR status

automated_checks.name: Daily Dependency Check
actions: Run npm outdated to check for updates
Run npm audit for security vulnerabilities
Generate update report with priority levels
Create GitHub issue if critical updates available

automated_checks.name: Hourly Health Check
actions: Ping Azure Static Web Apps endpoint

automated_checks.name: Weekly Security Scan
actions: Run full npm audit fix simulation
Review Azure AD OAuth token configuration

automated_checks.name: Monthly Performance Audit
actions: Review Azure Static Web Apps analytics

major_updates.automation: Create GitHub issue with migration guide

cost: Azure Static Web Apps bandwidth usage

dashboard_tools: GitHub Project Board for tracking updates
notes: Current status: 63 vulnerabilities detected (2 critical, 29 high, 26 moderate, 6 low)
Immediate action: Run npm audit fix to address non-breaking fixes
GitHub Dependabot should be enabled for automated security PRs
Consider upgrading to Next.js 15 for performance improvements (requires testing)
Monitor Supabase free tier limits: 500MB storage, 2GB bandwidth
Azure Static Web Apps free tier: 100GB bandwidth - track usage monthly
